mainEntity.name: When should I consider hiring a general contractor for my remodeling project?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider hiring a general contractor when your remodeling project involves multiple trades, requires permits, or is complex. A general contractor manages all aspects of the project, including hiring and coordinating subcontractors (plumbers, electricians, carpenters), overseeing the schedule, managing the budget, and ensuring quality and compliance with local building codes. This reduces stress for homeowners and ensures a cohesive project outcome. For larger projects like kitchen remodels, additions, or whole-home renovations, a general contractor is essential.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hire a general contractor for complex remodeling projects that involve multiple trades, require permits, or when you need professional management of the entire process.
